title: Validate focused Vitest artifacts before duration parsing reads them
outcome: Validate focused Vitest artifacts before duration parsing reads them
acceptance: Focused Vitest execution rejects oversized, symlink and non-regular artifacts before the duration path reads or parses them; validated normal reports retain their counts and duration output.
An integration regression shows that a rejected artifact cannot reach duration parsing and that a normal owned report still preserves native outcome and count validation.
